What incompetech.com said about each piece of the music player when it
was read and its file downloaded, on 2026-11-11.

The music files are kept once. The site plays the downloads themselves,
unchanged but for their names, from assets/music/; SHA256SUMS.txt beside
this file holds their checksums from the download, so those copies can be
checked against it (run sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt in this folder). The
pages that were read are not kept in this repository but with the owner's
working files; the SHA-256 of each is given here so that copy can be
checked.

The license, as incompetech's FAQ (https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/faq.html) gives it:
  "Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0"
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  The text: vendor/pristine/sounds/licenses/CC-BY-4.0.txt
  The credit it asks for: the piece's title, "Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)",
  the license line and the license address.
